description: This file is a shell script that performs a test suite to verify the handling of criss-cross renaming scenarios in Git. It defines functions to create files, sets up test cases involving renaming and swapping files, generates diffs with merge and rename detection options, and applies patches to validate correctness.

methods.name: create_file
methods.description: Creates a file with specified content repeated a number of times, used for setting up test files.

search-terms: shell script test for git rename handling
